content: .{@-स्थपतिन्यायः@} The rule according to which when a compound expression is capable of being dissolved as a कर्मधारय or a तत्पुरुष, the former is to be preferred to the latter. This is discussed and established by जैमिनि and शबर in <ls>MS. 6. 1. 51-52</ls> in connection with the expression निषादस्थपति.
